# osint.qalarc.com

> OSINT hub: username, phone, email and image discovery scans (sherlock, maigret, phoneinfoga, holehe, reverse image). Part of the Qalarc network.

## Facts
- Maker: Qalarc — https://qalarc.com
- Self-hosted OSINT scan orchestrator: username, phone and email pivots across dozens of platforms, with case management and a detective-dossier UI
- Free web app, no account required; scans are user-initiated for authorized investigations only

## Qalarc network
- [qalarc.com](https://qalarc.com): portfolio hub, 90 documented projects
